meta.description: Torn about a decision? Hold your question silently, begin with the Hare Krishna mahamantra, and open the Bhagavad Gita to a passage. Or read all 18 chapters.
meta.readDescription: Read all 18 chapters of the Bhagavad Gita online, one verse at a time: Sanskrit with English or Hindi meaning. Bookmark verses and pick up where you left off.

messages.wait: If you didn’t get your answer right now, maybe you must wait.

sacred.mantra:
Hare Krishna Hare Krishna
Krishna Krishna Hare Hare
Hare Rama Hare Rama
Rama Rama Hare Hare
sacred.purification: Om. Whether impure or pure, in any state, one who remembers the lotus-eyed Lord is purified within and without.

disclaimer: This page presents verses from the Bhagavad Gita for reflection and inspiration. Interpretations of ancient wisdom can vary across traditions, teachers, and contexts. The passages shown may offer guidance, but they are not guaranteed answers or substitutes for your own judgment.
